```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# load the boar data
```{r}
library(tidytracks)
wildboars_tt <- readRDS("./articles_data/wildboar_mt.rds")
wildboars_tt
```

Check the metadata
```{r}
show_meta(wildboars_tt)
```

Compute the kde
```{r}
wildboars_tt <- wildboars_tt %>% dplyr::group_by(Name)
wildboars_kde <- tt_hr_kde(wildboars_tt, levels = NULL,
                           h = "h_ref_indiv")
```

Check the output
```{r}
wildboars_kde
```

The h-values are the same as those computed with adehabitatHR

```{r}
sum(wildboars_kde$kde[[1]]$z)
sum(wildboars_kde$kde[[2]]$z)
sum(wildboars_kde$kde[[3]]$z)
sum(wildboars_kde$kde[[4]]$z)

```
There is something wrong here, as we seem to have identical kdes for all individuals
